script:
"=== adding to PATH ==="
$hermesBin = "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
$currentPath = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "User")
if ($currentPath -notlike "*hermes*") {
  [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("Path", "$currentPath;$hermesBin", "User")
  "Added to PATH"
} else { "Already in PATH" }
"=== config location ==="
Get-ChildItem "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes" -Filter "config*" | Select-Object Name, FullName | Select-Object -First 5
"=== checking hermes config ==="
hermes config list 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 10
